Chapter 744: Chapter 30: The Heavenly Gate Appears (Subscription Request)_2

Chapter 744: Chapter 30: The Heavenly Gate Appears (Subscription Request)_2

When these powerhouses of the Myriad Clans saw that Lin Yuan was the one leading the human civilization evolvers, their hearts were filled with astonishment.

The mysterious powerhouse from Xueyu Ancient Country, although he had only made a move once two hundred years ago, had stunned the four quarters and was still ranked among the nine greatest powerhouses.

Originally, many powerhouses of the Myriad Clans had speculated about the identity of this mysterious powerhouse,

and it was most likely that he was a unique special life form similar to the ‘Mother of the Tree Realm’ and the ‘Four Divine Kings’.

But now, upon seeing him, this mysterious powerhouse actually hailed from human civilization?

“Worthy of human civilization!”

...

“Terrifying, human civilization possesses such a powerhouse and yet there was no hint of it until today?”

“It might not necessarily be a powerhouse from human civilization; perhaps it was just a collaboration with human civilization….”

The powerhouses of the Myriad Clans discussed among themselves, most of them clearly understanding,

that they had no hope of leaving the Two-dimensional World. Their purpose in coming to Heavenly Mountain was to glimpse those lives strongest under the Supreme Being in the Cosmic Starry Skies.

“Lord Xueyu was not our human civilization’s powerhouse?”

Xuanyuan Dua glanced at the surrounding Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses and subtly shook her head.

From the tone a Supreme Being had instructed her, Xuanyuan Dua was almost certain that Lin Yuan was from human civilization.

If he were an outsider, a Supreme Being wouldn’t possibly trust him to hand over all the rare items.

…

Beyond the scroll.

A Supreme Being of the Star Alliance glanced at Xia Qin Supreme Being and rapidly transmitted a message: “So this is the confidence of your human civilization?”

As the powerhouses of the Myriad Clans saw Lin Yuan leading the human evolvers towards the summit of Heavenly Mountain, they naturally spread the news, and a Supreme Being of the Star Alliance immediately knew of it.

Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at the Supreme Being of the Star Alliance and said nothing.

By this point, there was no need for concealment; in face of the Celestial Gate soon to be opened, all forces needed to be gathered.

That’s why he had Lin Yuan join up with the human evolvers.

It wasn’t that he thought Xuanyuan Dua and other human evolvers could bring great help to Lin Yuan, but at least when other powerful entities were restrained, Xuanyuan Dua and the other human evolvers could intervene.

“I watched the video of your human civilization evolvers last battle. For an Eleventh Level Perfected Evolver to possess such combat power is indeed rare, but this time, when the Celestial Gate opens, competing with us special beings, you are still lacking,” said the Supreme Being of the Star Alliance again through transmission.

He was speaking the truth. In the Two-dimensional World, those strong special beings had far too great an advantage.

“Let’s see after the Celestial Gate opens.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being shook his head. The Supreme Being of the Star Alliance thought Lin Yuan was some Eleventh Level Perfected Evolver of human civilization.

But in fact, Lin Yuan was a Tenth Rank Evolver who had just entered the Tenth Rank not long ago.

In just over a hundred years, with the strength of the Tenth Rank, he had crushed Tuoba Ancient God and other Fifth Tier Eleventh Rank special beings. Such talent and ability were unheard of by Xia Qin Supreme Being.

The Four Divine Kings, being Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Life forms, probably wouldn’t even qualify to be compared to Lin Yuan if it weren’t for that Supreme weapon they had brought along.

…

Soon.

Lin Yuan arrived at the summit of Heavenly Mountain with the human evolvers.

The summit of Heavenly Mountain was vast and broad, where at this moment at least one hundred thousand Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses had gathered.

“Four Divine Kings?” Lin Yuan instantly spotted the four-armed man sitting cross-legged in the central area of the mountain.

Nobody from the Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses dared approach this four-armed man, which was why Lin Yuan immediately noticed him.

“Is this who Xia Qin Supreme Being warned me to treat cautiously, and if uncertain, to yield this Celestial Gate spot and prepare for the next opening?”

Lin Yuan observed the Four Divine Kings carefully. In Xia Qin Supreme Being’s eyes, it wasn’t the Four Divine Kings himself that was fearsome, but the Supreme weapon he had brought along.

A fully refined Supreme weapon might unleash a power far beyond the limits of the Two-dimensional World.

“His arms…” Lin Yuan’s gaze lingered on the four arms of the Four Divine Kings; this was also where the opponent’s Supreme weapon integrated.

“They don’t look strong, but it could also be that he’s concealing his breath, not exerting his full strength,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Just like him now, as long as he doesn’t deliberately exude his aura, the other Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses would not be able to detect anything.

The reason those Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses feared Lin Yuan was entirely due to his dominant battle against Tuoba Ancient God two hundred years ago.

“Let’s observe a bit more.”

Lin Yuan shifted his gaze from the Four Divine Kings, turning his attention to other Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses.

Among them, a thin old man burning like flames and a three-meter-tall robust man and a few other powerhouses caught Lin Yuan’s eye.

According to the intelligence he had obtained, these were all Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Lives, though they didn’t pose as much of a threat as the Four Divine Kings with a Supreme weapon.

Still, they were not to be underestimated.

In the outer world, these Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Beings were simply not something Lin Yuan could contend with, but in the Two-dimensional World, things were unpredictable.

Under equal starting conditions, even if competing with a Supreme Being, as long as there was enough time, Lin Yuan was confident of winning.

…

In the central area of the summit of Heavenly Mountain, the Four Divine Kings opened his eyes, glanced around, and slightly furrowed his brows: “Too many.”

The summit of Heavenly Mountain was indeed vast, but at this moment, more than one hundred thousand Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses had gathered, and the number was still increasing every moment, making the Four Divine Kings somewhat irritable.

“Four Divine Kings, how about we join forces and clear the field by screening?”

The distant thin old man who seemed to be burning with flames spoke up, while the other few Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Life forms looked over as well.
